conceptual_source: Choose CSP or a Riemannian decoder.
Compare on later trials at a fixed decision time.
source.exact_result_and_qualification: Selection did not beat fixed CSP at 60 calibration trials per session. This was a retrospective comparison using previously inspected later trials.

encoding.direction: Top to bottom categorical evaluation sequence; lengths encode no trial counts or durations.
encoding.calibration_band: Early trials inform the decoder choice.
encoding.fork: CSP and Riemannian are alternatives; no session-level choice is asserted.
encoding.shared_bracket_and_band: A shared fixed-time evaluation rule on later trials.
encoding.comparison: Compare the decoder choice with fixed CSP.

data: No empirical values, private files, EEG waveform traces, invented scores or outcome magnitudes were used.
html_requirement: Keep the exact result and retrospective/previously-inspected qualification visibly in the adjacent HTML. The mobile graphic omits the long visible outcome paragraph; its accessible description preserves that scope.
limitations: Evaluation schematic only; not scientific validation, blind or held-out testing, prospective evaluation or live deployment.
